edits.new: No rule here fixes a business value: the months, the tables, the age-basis fields and the end action are all data in the request. P5 rwb-document owns both retention tables, `retention_rule` and `retention_action`, the load and the retention Schedule JOB-17 (ASM-0076); this service holds no rule table and no Schedule, keeps only a contract read, receives the rule version, the run date and the rules in the run request, validates them against its own tables and applies them to its own eight tables. Each owner applies the rule to its own schema, and the suite asserts the rule version, legal holds and the decision-log exclusion through the owners' APIs and Temporal visibility. Each archive or purge action writes a decision record whose decision code and final call come from LOV-DECISION and the final-call list through the rwb-case reference-data contract, with ruleId empty, the run reference in inputsRef, and the product, table, counts, hold report reference and archive location in actions and outcome; the value names are settled with the reference-data owner before the first joint environment.
